lines: One chunk holds at least 90.0 % of a page, so the browser fetches practically the whole page before it shows anything:
tasks-dashboard.mjs: 4 files, 1,965,160 B, of which index-D77uAyM1.chunk.mjs is 1,954,838 B (99.5 %).
tasks-talk.mjs: 3 files, 1,960,550 B, of which index-D77uAyM1.chunk.mjs is 1,954,838 B (99.7 %).

Code splitting puts what the first paint does not need behind a dynamic import, and then the browser fetches it when the code asks. Which part of a page that is does not follow from the build output; the source decides it.
2 packages are imported by their root in src, so the whole barrel is reachable and the bundler keeps whatever it cannot prove unused:

@nextcloud/vue: 415,171 B in 98 modules, 17.9 % of the static path of tasks-main.mjs, imported by its root in 8 files: App.vue (useIsMobile), components/AppSidebar/Alarm/AlarmDateTimePickerModal.vue (NcButton, NcDateTimePickerNative, NcModal), and 6 more. It is imported per module as well, through 27 other specifiers.
markdown-it: 48,946 B in 51 modules, 2.1 % of the static path of tasks-main.mjs, imported by its root in components/AppSidebar/NotesItem.vue (MarkdownIt).
Importing the module that is used instead of the package root lets the bundler drop the rest of the barrel.
ncmake's lint-vue-imports workflow gates exactly this specifier for @nextcloud/vue, so this finding is that red check with a byte figure attached.

16 components of @nextcloud/vue are delivered although no file in src names them, no other dependency names them and no component named by either imports them: 6,054 B, 0.3 % of the static path of tasks-main.mjs, next to 27 components the source names and 11 those pull in.
NcRichText 5,027 B, NcEmojiPicker 559 B, NcRelatedResourcesPanel 152 B, NcSettingsSelectGroup 128 B, NcSelectTags 52 B, NcRichContenteditable 37 B, and 10 more.

These arrive through the root import, and @nextcloud/dialogs on the same page imports the root as well: as long as one module imports the barrel, the whole component set is reachable, so the bundler must keep it. Per-component imports in the app drop nothing while that package does; the specifier to change is in @nextcloud/dialogs.
Every delivered file in js carries a source map, so every byte can be charged to the package and the module it came from.
